units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Deuteronomy 17:18">Targ. Y. Deut. XVII, 18</cite> <he>פַּרְשַׁת אורייתא</he> (not <cite ref="Q02027"><he>פרשא</he></cite>; h. text <cite ref="M02939"><he>משנה</he></cite>).

<cite ref="Megillah 4a:9">Meg. 4ᵃ</cite> (interpret. <he>ולשנותה</he>, <cite ref="Megillah 4a:9">ib.</cite>) <he>כגון דאמרי אינשי אעבור פ׳ דא וכ׳</he> as people say, I will peruse this section and read it over again.
Y. Ned. VIII, beg. 40ᵈ עד דניחסל פַּרְשְׁתִי until I have finished my parashah; a. e.—Pl. פַּרְשְׁיָיתָא (fr. פרשיתא).

<cite ref="Berakhot 8b:5">Ib.</cite> <he>אשלימו פַּרְשְׁיוֹתַיְיכוּ וכ׳</he> (Hebraism. for <he>פַּרְשְׁיָיתַיְיכוּ</he>; Ms. M. <he>פַּרְשַׁיְיכוּ</he>), v. <cite ref="Q02033"><he>פָּרָשָׁה</he></cite>.
